# Dhruv Arora

Personal portfolio of Dhruv Arora, a computer science and math student at UW-Madison and software engineering intern at Autodesk.

- Develops and markets Synthesis, Autodesk's open source robotics simulator for FIRST students (5K to 20K+ users during his tenure).
- Writes Rust CLI/TUI tools (astute, dirnt, monkeytype-tui) and agent-native software.
- Projects, experience, skills, and awards are on the single-page site.
- Contact: a_dhruv@outlook.com. GitHub: https://github.com/Dhruv-0-Arora

The site is an explorable 3D world: a mountain range where every summit, shoulder and lakeshore holds a project he built or contributes to. Visitors ride a mountain railway from the hub in the valley to each site and back, press F to drive the Dozer robot (a real Synthesis .mira Mirabuf protobuf file parsed live in the browser) up the trails, or press T to fly a full-size 1903 Wright Flyer. A static page serves reduced-motion, small-screen and no-WebGL visitors.
